November is here, and while we already started seeing some early Black Friday deals peeking up in the last few days of October, we’re getting some more to kick off this week’s Green Deals. The standout leader in the pack is the extremely rare savings from MOD Bikes’ Black Friday event , with options like the stylish Easy 3 Cruiser e-bike down at $2,199 and others from $1,799. Right behind that is EcoFlow’s early Black Friday 72-hour flash sale , with offers like the 3,072Wh DELTA 3 Ultra Power Station with 2x 220W solar panels and a FREE TRAIL 200 DC station down at $1,699 , as well as others from $199. We also have deals on the popular Worx 13A Electric Leaf Mulcher , as well as Anker’s eufy SoloCam E42 Solar Security Multi-Cam kits with HomeBase 3, and more waiting for you below. As always on a Monday, you can find all the deals from last week rounded up together in our latest Electrified Weekly edition here .
Head below for other New Green Deals we’ve found today and, of course, Electrek ’s best EV buying and leasing deals . Also, check out the new Electrek Tesla Shop for the best deals on Tesla accessories .
Rare MOD Bikes savings land ahead of Black Friday – Easy 3 cruiser $200 off, more from $1,799
MOD Bikes is having a rare sale for Black Friday for the month of November or for as long as supplies last, with up to $400 discounts on its premium e-bikes. My top pick is the Easy 3 Cruiser e-bike that is down at $2,199 shipped from a $2,399 full price during the event. It’s extremely rare for this brand to have sales since 2025 began, with the last one being the New Year Sale at the top of the year, which saw this model discounted to this same rate, only beaten out by a dip lower to $2,159 in December 2025. You’re getting $200 struck from the tag here for the best price of this year. There are also options for the counterpart Easy SideCar 3 e-bike at $3,499 shipped , as well as the upgraded Easy SideCar Sahara also down at $3,499 shipped . You can learn more about this e-bike in my hands-one review here , or head below to check out the full lineup of deals.
MOD Bikes’ rare Black Friday e-bike deals:
City+ Step-Thru 3 Folding e-bike: $1,799 (Reg. $1,999) 28 MPH for up to 45 miles
Berlin Step-Thru 3 Commuter e-bike: $1,799 (Reg. $1,999) 28 MPH for up to 45 miles

Black 3 Off-Road e-bike: $2,199 (Reg. $2,399) 28 MPH for up to 50 miles
Groove SideCar 3 e-bike: $3,099 (Reg. $3,499) 28 MPH for up to 50 miles
Easy SideCar 3 e-bike: $3,499 (Reg. $3,899) 28 MPH for up to 50 miles
Easy SideCar Sahara e-bike: $3,499 (Reg. $3,899) 28 MPH for up to 50 miles with upgraded features/sidecar with doggie door
EcoFlow Early Black Friday flash sale drops DELTA 3 Ultra 440W solar bundle + FREE TRAIL 200DC to $1,699, more
EcoFlow has officially launched its Early Black Friday Sale event , complete with FREE gifts with purchases over $600 – plus, it’s starting the whole thing with a 72-hour flash sale lineup of four units, too. Among those flash offers, you can find reliable backup support from options like the DELTA 3 Ultra 3,072Wh Portable Power Station and 2x 220W solar panels down at $1,699 shipped – plus you get a FREE TRAIL 200DC power station ($199 value), beating out Amazon by $100 . It starts directly from EcoFlow with a newer $1,999 MSRP these days, while we still see it climb as high as $2,599 at Amazon. Since July ended, we’ve been seeing this bundle discounted down to $1,799, and things usually going lower for $1,699 before then, aside from Prime Day in June when it fell to $1,599 – though none of those deals gave you the free TRAIL station. The deal here gives you $300 savings off the going rate ($499 total savings with the free station), landing it at the second-best price of 2026. You can also find the standalone DELTA 3 Ultra down at $1,299 shipped , matching the price at Amazon. Head below to check out the full flash lineup or check out the full Black Friday Sale lineup on the main page here .

EcoFlow’s first early BF flash lineup:

DELTA Pro (3,600Wh) with 2x 220W solar panels: $2,199 (Reg. $2,997) | matched at Amazon
With leaves finally falling, this 13A Worx electric mulcher is ready for the yard work at $125 (Up to $65 off)
Over at Amazon, folks can pick up the popular Worx 13A Electric Leaf Mulcher down at $124.99 shipped right now. Since September we’ve been seeing it climb up to $190 at Amazon (as opposed to its direct $200 MSRP), with things having only gone as high as $150 for 2026 before then. The deal here gives you a $65 markdown for the second-lowest price of the year, just $6 above the annual low we saw for a short period during October’s Prime Day sale. You can also find more Worx tool deals in the official Amazon storefront here .
Anker’s Apple Home-ready solar security cam bundles fall as low as $360, no sub required
Through its official eufyHome Amazon storefront, Anker is currently offering its SoloCam E42 Solar Security 2-Cam Kit with HomeBase 3 down at $359.97 shipped , matching the price we’re seeing direct from the brand’s website . While it may carry a $450 MSRP directly, it’s almost entirely gone for $400 at the highest at Amazon, though there was a spike to that higher rate back in early June. The deal here gives you a solid $40 markdown off the going rate (and $90 off the MSRP), which is the best price we have tracked since June’s Prime Day event. You can also find the larger SoloCam E2 4-Cam Kit down at $499.98 shipped , also matching the price direct from the brand’s website . Of course, you can find other Anker smart security deals in the official Amazon storefront here .
